claims.evidence: Fontana Ranuccio (FR sd-295) is a Middle Pleistocene Stephanorhinus (paper); ReadMe maps _1313-_1315 to Fontana Ranuccio. Species not stated, so genus NCBITaxon:2003758.
Haughton specimen CMNFV59632 is Epiaceratherium sp. (paper) but Epiaceratherium has no NCBITaxon entry; family Rhinocerotidae (NCBITaxon:9803, also PRIDE organism) used.
Tooth enamel flakes drilled avoiding dentine; UBERON:0001752 enamel. Tusk enamel (i2) and molar enamel from same specimen.

claims.location: source name / comment[data file] all rows
claims.evidence: ReadMe.txt key; names FR2/FR3/FR4 from paper (FR2 HCl, FR3/FR4 TFA) matched to _1313/_1314/_1315 by ReadMe order (one HCl, two TFA) - FR2 is the only HCl subsample.
ReadMe lists _1316/_1606/_1962 as laboratory extraction blanks; paper: extraction blank per sample set.
Raw headers of _1313,_1314,_1315,_1316,_1606,_1608 report 'Q Exactive HF-X'. Paper says Exploris 480 was used for CMNFV59632, but the tusk file _1608 (2019, QE7) header says HF-X; raw data wins.
Raw headers of _1963 and _1962 report Orbitrap Exploris 480.

claims.value: variable only: Oxidation M/P/W, Deamidated N/Q, Arg->Orn, Gln->pyro-Glu, Glu->pyro-Glu, Phospho S/T
claims.evidence: summary.txt Variable modifications list 'Oxidation (MPW);Arg->Orn;Deamidation (NQ);Gln->pyro-Glu;Glu->pyro-Glu;Phospho (ST)', Fixed empty; paper: 'No fixed modifications were set'. Standard run only; Aromatic/His/TryptOx runs use additional modifications and are separate searches.
No enzymatic digestion performed (enamel peptides hydrolysed in vivo); MaxQuant search used Unspecific enzyme mode.
dataProcessingProtocol: precursor mass tolerance 10 ppm (not in parameters.txt).
parameters.txt MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm; PRIDE protocol prose says 0.05 Da. Deposited search output preferred; conflict documented.
Data-dependent top-10 mode; PRIDE experiment type PRIDE:0000627.
FR2 demineralized in 10% HCl, FR3/FR4 and Haughton samples in 10% TFA. Concentration (10%) not carried in the value.

limitations: Age, sex, developmental stage of the fossil individuals are not given per sample: not available.
Blanks 1316/1606/1962 cannot be assigned to a specific specimen set from the ReadMe; each is its own negative-control source.
No raw files are deposited for Dmanisi Stephanorhinus or medieval goat (only MaxQuant output zips); these are not annotated because the SDRF is per raw file.
Search-parameter zips for Aromatic/His/TryptOx runs were not opened beyond zip listings; modifications derive from Standard run summaries only.
Epiaceratherium sp. has no NCBITaxon entry; family level used.

Precursor tolerance: PRIDE protocol says 10 ppm; the paper (per round-1 reviewer) says 20 ppm first search and 4.5 ppm for the final search; parameters.txt has no precursor tolerance. 10 ppm (PRIDE) retained.
Phospho: PRIDE/paper say S,T,Y but deposited MaxQuant summary says Phospho (ST); deposit used (S,T).
Paper says tusk sample (_1608) excluded from analysis (few peptides) but its raw file is deposited, so it is annotated.
FR3/FR4 are two same-specimen same-acid subsamples; recorded as biological replicate 1 and 2 (FR2 HCl is replicate 1 of its own treatment).
